query: What type of vehicles are permitted to use bus lanes during restricted hours other than omnibuses, bicycles, emergency service, and police vehicles?
reference_answer: Non-scheduled buses, such as school and factory buses, are permitted to use bus lanes during restricted hours.
context:
[Document 1]
Non-scheduled buses, such as school and factory buses, are permitted to use bus lanes during restricted hours.

[Document 2]
There will be signages to inform eligible foreign visitors to use the designated lanes for immigration clearance at the respective passenger halls.These designated lanes are currently available at Tuas Checkpoint, Woodlands Checkpoint and Marina Bay Cruise Centre.Travellers of all nationalities, entering via Changi Airport Arrival Terminals are eligible to seek clearance at the automated lanes.

[Document 3]
The riding of pedal-cycles, including trishaws, tricycles, and bicycles, is prohibited.

[Document 4]
A single group QR code can contain up to 10 profiles.For travellers who selected "Motorcycle" as the vehicle type, only a maximum of two profiles are allowed in this group QR code.For travellers who selected "Lorry" or “Bus” as the vehicle type, only a maximum of four profiles are allowed in this group QR code.Nevertheless, travellers are free to create and customise multiple groups of QR codes, depending on their travel needs.

[Document 5]
To allow enough room to stop safely if the vehicle stops abruptly.
answer: According to [Document 1], non-scheduled buses like school and factory buses are permitted to use bus lanes during restricted hours. No other specific types are mentioned. [Document 3] states that pedal-cycles, tricycles, and trishaws are prohibited. Therefore, the only additional permitted vehicle besides buses is non-scheduled buses. [Document 4] mentions motorcycles and buses (including articulated buses) can share lanes with these buses. [Document 5] confirms buses can use lanes. Hence, the answer is buses.
